lines.line: lls_homes: Lists every home you own with its number, condition, tenant and rent. The other lls_ commands take that number.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_homes (help lls_homes in the console).

lines.line: lls_info [home]: Shows everything about one home: value, condition, stats, traits, upgrades, services, tenant, children and the last log lines. A home is its number from lls_homes or "here" (where you are docked).
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_info (help lls_info in the console).

lines.line: lls_givehome [size]: Gives you a new home on the market you are docked at, for free. Size is shack, studio, small_house, house, villa or estate (or 1 to 6). With no size, one this market sells.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_givehome (help lls_givehome in the console).

lines.line: lls_listings [reroll]: Lists the homes for sale on the market you are docked at. With reroll, a new list replaces it.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_listings (help lls_listings in the console).

lines.line: lls_condition [home] <0-100>: Sets a home's condition. 0 condemns it.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_condition (help lls_condition in the console).

lines.line: lls_repairall: Repairs every home you own to 100% for free and cleans off graffiti and dirt.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_repairall (help lls_repairall in the console).

lines.line: lls_tenant [home] [faction id]: A new tenant moves into an empty home at once, with all traits known. The faction is the market's own unless you name one.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_tenant (help lls_tenant in the console).

lines.line: lls_applicants [home] [1-10]: People apply to rent an empty home, 3 unless you give a number. See them on the home's Tenants tab.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_applicants (help lls_applicants in the console).

lines.line: lls_mood [home] <-30 to 30>: Sets the tenant's mood, which adds to their happiness and drifts back to 0 by 1 a day.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_mood (help lls_mood in the console).

lines.line: lls_wealth [home] <1-6>: Sets the tenant's wealth, from E (1) to S (6).
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_wealth (help lls_wealth in the console).

lines.line: lls_housetrait <home> <add|remove> <trait id>: Adds or removes a house trait. lls_ids housetraits lists them.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_housetrait (help lls_housetrait in the console).

lines.line: lls_tenanttrait <home> <add|remove|reveal> [trait id]: Adds or removes a tenant trait, or reveals all of the tenant's traits. lls_ids tenanttraits lists them.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_tenanttrait (help lls_tenanttrait in the console).

lines.line: lls_event <home> <event id>: Makes a house or tenant event happen now, whatever its odds. lls_ids events lists them.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_event (help lls_event in the console).

lines.line: lls_upgrade <home> <add|remove> <upgrade id>: Builds an upgrade at once for free, or removes it. lls_ids upgrades lists them.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_upgrade (help lls_upgrade in the console).

lines.line: lls_month: Runs the end-of-month pass now: rent, wear, reputation and your family's money. The rent shows in this month's income report.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_month (help lls_month in the console).

lines.line: lls_marry <home> <name>: One of your officers or administrators marries you and moves into the home, whatever their level. You move into the home first if it is empty.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_marry (help lls_marry in the console).

lines.line: lls_baby [home]: Your partner has a baby now.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_baby (help lls_baby in the console).

lines.line: lls_growup [home]: Every child in the home grows up now and starts the life they wished for.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_growup (help lls_growup in the console). After it runs: "1 child in Leafy Cottage grew up. Those with a wish started their life; talk to the others to choose one."

lines.line: lls_ids <sizes|housetraits|tenanttraits|events|upgrades>: Lists the ids the other lls_ commands take.
lines.when: Console Commands: the help text of lls_ids (help lls_ids in the console).
